description: This file defines the MerchantConfigurationDao interface, which extends a generic DAO interface, and declares methods for accessing merchant configuration data associated with a store, including retrieving configurations by key or type.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationDao
classes.description: Interface for accessing merchant configuration data, extending a generic DAO for entity persistence.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a merchant configuration based on a key and merchant store.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves all merchant configurations associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists merchant configurations filtered by type and store.
